name: nginx
description: Agent skills for writing nginx.conf, building NGINX from source, developing modules, and contributing to the NGINX codebase.

interface.longDescription: Agent-agnostic skills for the NGINX open source web server, reverse proxy, and load balancer. Use them to write and review nginx.conf (contexts, location matching, upstream/proxy, TLS, HTTP/2, HTTP/3/QUIC), configure and build NGINX from this repository with auto/configure (static and dynamic modules), develop HTTP/stream/core modules that follow the Development Guide and in-tree code style, and contribute changes with NGINX commit message conventions and nginx-tests. Skills are grounded in the directives and configure flags defined in this source tree.
defaultPrompt: Review this nginx.conf for location and proxy issues
Enable TLS and HTTP/3 for this NGINX build
Scaffold an HTTP module matching NGINX style
